description.value: A 10-site RV park attached to a motel in central Quesnel, open March–October, with full hookups, flush toilets, and showers; a cedar hedge gives privacy and the site is walking distance from the Fraser River's historic wooden bridge and a riverfront trail.

address.value: 100 Ewing Ave, Quesnel, BC V2J 1R4, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms this is a 28-unit motel with a 10-space RV Park and Campground in Quesnel, BC. Amenities page explicitly lists 'Showers Available', 'Water Available', 'Power Available', and 'Dog Friendly'. Food nearby is confirmed by 'Family Restaurants and a Neighbourhood Pub are very close by' and West Park Mall references. Online reservation form exists. No mention of hiker/biker-specific sites, cyclist discounts, or bike-specific amenities.
concerns: Primarily an RV park with full hookups; no explicit mention of tent-only or hiker/biker sites—touring cyclists may need to confirm tent camping is accepted
RV campground operates seasonally (Mar-Oct per amenities page)
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active RV park and campground in Quesnel with showers, water, power, and nearby food options. Useful stop for touring cyclists on Highway 97 through the Cariboo region, though no dedicated hiker/biker sites are mentioned.
enrichment_extras.notes: Dog friendly per amenities page. Free WiFi available. On-site park host/manager. Flush toilets available.

wow_evidence: Showers Available, Water Available, Power Available
